dim.title: Use cases (TypeSafe categories)
dim.note: Measured on a separate sealed 600-item TypeSafe-20 image bank (30 items per use case, frozen 10 Oct 2026). Not part of the v0.3 score or rank.
dim.poolNote: both systems: the same 600 sealed TypeSafe-20 items

cats.label: Model routing
cats.covers: deciding which LLM or model tier should handle a prompt; classifying a request's intent, domain, difficulty or risk to pick a model

cats.label: Legal & compliance
cats.covers: contracts, policies, regulations, eligibility rules, checking documents against written requirements

cats.label: Customer support
cats.covers: classifying tickets and customer intents, urgency, refunds, routing cases to a team, checking support replies

cats.label: Other
cats.covers: none of the above: general reasoning, arithmetic or date puzzles, everyday assistant requests without a business workflow

cats.label: E-commerce
cats.covers: product listings, product attributes, orders and deliveries, seller catalog policy

cats.label: Risk assessment
cats.covers: estimating probabilities and severity of risks, incidents, vendor or underwriting risk

cats.label: Insurance claims
cats.covers: first-notice-of-loss reports, claim complexity, missing information, claim triage

cats.label: Financial crime
cats.covers: suspicious transactions, KYC, fraud alerts, entity matching for investigations

cats.label: Moderation
cats.covers: user content moderation: toxicity, harassment, spam, unsafe advice, personal data exposure

cats.label: Feature extraction
cats.covers: turning natural-language data into probabilistic features or estimates for a downstream prediction

cats.label: Knowledge graphs
cats.covers: entity types, relationships between records, contradictions between facts, multi-step lookups across linked facts

cats.label: LLM guardrails
cats.covers: checking LLM inputs, outputs and tool calls: prompt injection, jailbreaks, policy violations, tool-call errors, answer quality

cats.label: Search & retrieval
cats.covers: scoring query-to-candidate relevance, reranking results, selecting useful context for RAG

cats.label: Lead generation
cats.covers: matching companies or inbound messages to an ideal customer profile, buyer intent, prioritising and routing sales leads

cats.label: Code linting
cats.covers: checking code or writing against conventions and guidelines, as in CI review of code

cats.label: Demand forecasting
cats.covers: purchase intent, product interest, demand and supply signals for forecasting

cats.label: Gaming
cats.covers: player reports, in-game chat, game support

cats.label: Science
cats.covers: screening papers, labelling research passages or survey answers, checking that citations support claims, methodology checks

cats.label: Recruiting
cats.covers: resumes, applications, interview feedback, matching candidates to roles

cats.label: Advertising
cats.covers: ad creatives, campaign copy, brand safety, prohibited claims in ads

metric: Chance-corrected accuracy (0 = chance, 100 = perfect) over the use case's 30 items; errors count as wrong.

reference.pipeline: offline Qwen3-VL-4B caption (greedy, 2,048-token cap) -> Jev 1.13.0 on question + options + caption
reference.note: Of its 600 items, 9 count as wrong: 7 captions hit the 2,048-token cap and 2 Jev responses whose probabilities did not sum to 1 were rejected by the pre-registered strict parser.
